events: Eruption: Agung, Bali (Mar 1963) - gong; the drone darkens as the aerosols cool the planet
1966: routine satellite coverage begins - fewer storms before this is partly fewer observed
Solar maximum (1968-11) - the shimmer is fullest
Satellites begin measuring Arctic sea ice (1978-11) - a high glass voice fades in
Solar maximum (1979-12) - the shimmer is fullest
Eruption: El Chichon, Mexico (Apr 1982) - gong; the drone darkens as the aerosols cool the planet
CO2 passes 350 ppm (1987-11) - the drone is louder and more open
Strongest winter NAO (1989-02, +2.0) - the loudest wind
Solar maximum (1989-06) - the shimmer is fullest
Eruption: Pinatubo, Philippines (Jun 1991) - gong; the drone darkens as the aerosols cool the planet
Global SST anomaly passes +0.5 C (1997-06) - cello in three voices
Solar maximum (2002-03) - the shimmer is fullest
Most active ATL season by ACE: 2005 (244)
Ocean heat content (0-2000 m) past the halfway mark of its rise (2008-06) - the contrabass adds a fifth
Lowest September sea ice in the record: 2012 (3.57 million km2) - the glass voice at its thinnest
Solar maximum (2014-04) - the shimmer is fullest
Global temperature passes +0.8 C vs 1951-80 (2014-10) - a high violin enters
CO2 passes 400 ppm (2015-03) - the drone is louder and more open
Eruption: Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai (Jan 2022) - gong; mostly water vapour, not sulphate: the drone barely darkens
The AMO record ends (2023-01; the index is no longer updated) - its pad falls silent and the mode holds
CO2 passes 420 ppm (2023-04) - the drone is louder and more open
